prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a rear-end collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1482; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Rear bumper cover cracked across the center with the left tail lamp housing broken and the trunk lid edge pushed inward, all consistent with the rear-end impact as described. Reinforcement bar and rear quarter panel inspected; no sign of older repairs or prior damage on the vehicle, and nothing in the file suggests earlier loss. Proposed plan: replace bumper cover, tail lamp assembly and reinforcement bar, repair and refinish the trunk lid edge, and recalibrate the parking sensors. Labor hours are in line with the damage shown. The invoices submitted reflect a single set of charges with no duplicated line items. Recommend approval of the repair plan as written.
